findings.detail: route-G domain densities come from admissible_pairs in ORDER (h,c,cb,...), so the pair is (c,cb); P15 Sigma coordinates (d13.ccb_basis, defect.ghost_equation_relation) use sector_basis('cb','c'). pw_vertex takes ordered left derivatives, so V[c.cb#k] = -V[(cb,c)#k] (own ratio -1, k=0,1). Inserting the (cb,c) Sigma coordinates into (c,cb) labels without the -1 produces the apparent 'needs -1'. Converted, the derived +1 closes the full MS-bar counterterm in h.c, c.b, c.cbs. Fix: convert orientation (or build ccb_basis with ('c','cb')); add the tree control sigma0(S0_Kc + S0_cbc) = 0 (own: 0 entries).
quotient_coordinates c.cb entries (-3/8, 1/4) are (cb,c)-oriented under (c,cb) labels; in route-G orientation they are (+3/8, -1/4) (same root cause as K1).

projected_restoration_verified follows from the identity + locality; claim_status calls it independent because S_ct has a nonzero c.b image, which is only true because the package S_ct omits the c.cb counterterm.

projected_identity_verified requires 'every mutation changing the outcome'; the 3 blind variations (drop D11, drop D13, flip K.c) are moved to insensitive_variations (disclosed). Full c.b closure would detect two of them.
J1 correct in substance; 'Q(i) is the physical field' should read 'counts over Q(i) equal real dimensions under a compatible real structure'.
